evidence.summary: The public standard-library verifier test suite passed against the exact capsule and exercised both the valid baseline and deliberate integrity or semantic failures.

retention.limitation: The complete test program is public in this capsule; transient test directories and command output are not retained as evidence.

limitations: Passing tests establish the verifier's exercised behavior, not the truth of private experimental records.
The verifier and tests remain reviewable software and may contain defects outside the tested cases.
